author: Hero Hei
description:
The Japanese game 'Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis' released only a few days ago and things were going well for the most part. A cute art style, fun gameplay, very positive reviews - but something was off. Players quickly began to notice that the English localization was a complete mess. The EN localizers shoving in their own political propaganda and reddit-mod-esque dialogue. The situation proliferating so much that the devs have become aware and already began hotfixing the mess, with more remedies implied to be on the way. It's a very sad situation. In this video, we'll go over everything in detail as well as an in-depth look into the localization company behind this disaster, 'Dragonbaby', and some of the higher ranking members especially one Jeremy Blaustein who is a notorious figure in his own right. 

Gameplay: Marvel Rivals
